_comment: 90-day content database. Edit freely; the CLI validates it. status: planned|in_production|ready|queued|published|skipped

days.concept: Hero portrait, black shirt, direct but calm stare.
days.location: minimal dark interior with a tall window
beats: half-body portrait by a tall window, one shoulder toward camera, hands relaxed

days.location: old-stone city street, ambiguous European-looking architecture
beats: walking mid-stride along the pavement, glancing across the street, coat moving
close-up: gloved hand sets the black helmet on the seat
medium: he leans against the bike, face half in shadow
detail: headlight flicks on, cut to black

days.concept: Coffee shop, book open, face partially hidden.
days.location: small quiet café with wooden tables
beats: he reads, cup raised, hiding the lower half of his face
overhead detail: the green book open beside a black coffee
window reflection of him, blurred street behind

days.location: grand hotel lobby, marble and warm brass light, no signage
beats: tracking from behind as he crosses the lobby
he passes a concierge desk without stopping
he disappears into a corridor

days.location: mirrored hotel elevator, warm brass panels
beats: mirror selfie in the elevator, phone covering mouth, tie-less black suit

days.location: inside a dark premium car on a city avenue
beats: POV: hand on steering wheel, watch visible, city lights streak across the windscreen
traffic light reflection turns green
the car pulls away into the dark

days.location: high private balcony over an unidentifiable city
beats: seen from behind leaning on the railing, sleeves rolled, city haze below

days.location: garage exit to an empty road
beats: close-up: he pulls on a black glove, flexes the hand
ignition: thumb on the starter, dash glows
the bike rolls out of the garage onto an empty road

days.concept: Dinner table for one, second chair empty.
days.location: dim upscale restaurant, candle-lit table for two
beats: he sits alone at a table set for two, the second chair empty, a black matchbook beside his glass

days.location: neutral bathroom doorway with soft window light
beats: tight portrait, hair wet after a shower, droplets on the shoulders, eyes slightly down

days.location: narrow city street in the rain, glowing shopfronts with no readable signs
beats: wide: he walks through the rain without an umbrella
medium: rain beads on the coat shoulders
he turns a corner and is gone
the green book open on the desk, his hand holding the page, ring visible
close-up of a handwritten line on a paper slip tucked in the book (text added in post)
coffee cup and the watch on the desk
he walks straight toward the lens
at the last moment he passes without looking
camera holds on the empty street

days.location: cliffside coastal road town with whitewashed walls, no landmarks
beats: car door opens, his boots step onto warm stone
he walks to a low wall overlooking the sea
he exhales, does not turn around
two coffees on a small marble table, his hand with the ring on one cup, a second cup with a faint lipstick mark
his hand rests on the table, her hand with the gold bracelet lies beside it, almost touching
shaky phone video from behind as he walks ahead
he glances back over his shoulder and almost smiles
he shakes his head and keeps walking
focus on him at the table, he looks across the room
rack focus to her silhouette at the bar against the window
back to him, a slight smile he hides
close-up of his hand holding hers, bracelet visible
both shadows on the cobblestones
her tan bag swinging at the edge of frame

days.location: hotel room breakfast on a bed tray, white sheets
beats: POV: two cups and pastries on a tray
her hand with the bracelet steals a croissant
his hand reaches to stop it, gives up

days.concept: 3 photos from a quiet day together.
beats: he reads on a sofa, she took the photo
their two pairs of shoes by the door
her blurred profile laughing in the background, out of focus

days.location: his apartment, dark chair by a window
beats: her tan structured bag and a glass perfume bottle on his black chair, his jacket on the backrest
wide from behind: two figures walk across a bridge
her arm hooks into his
they disappear into the city lights

days.concept: His candid smile, implied she is behind camera.
beats: he leans on the counter with a coffee, genuinely smiling at the person behind the camera
across the table: he watches her, she is out of focus in the foreground
she says something, he laughs and looks down
her hand with the bracelet lifts a glass

days.concept: Road trip, her hand on dashboard.
beats: passenger POV: her hand taps the dashboard to the music
his hand on the wheel, watch catching sunlight
the road opens to the sea
two half-full wine glasses on a balcony table, a cream cardigan on the chair
she walks ahead barefoot holding her sandals, hair in the wind, face not visible

days.concept: Reel ending with her entering frame.
beats: he adjusts his cuff in a hallway mirror
he looks at his watch, impatient
she steps into frame from the side, face cropped, he stops
kettle pours over a pour-over coffee
he leans on the counter, hair messy, half-awake
he takes the first sip by the window

days.location: dark wooden desk with laptop and notebook
beats: laptop open with a blurred unreadable screen, notebook, his hand on a pen, watch visible
post-workout mirror photo, damp hair, towel around the neck, black gym bag on the bench
he chooses lemons in a produce aisle
a paper bag with bread and flowers on the passenger seat
keys and bag on the kitchen counter
close-up: he tightens the chain with a wrench
he wipes grease off his hands
he sits back and looks at the bike

days.location: old bookstore with tall shelves, spines unreadable
beats: he pulls a book from a high shelf, seen through the shop window
curtains pulled open
shower steam, cold water on his face
shirt buttoned, watch clasped, keys taken
he eats alone by the window, reading on his phone, relaxed
he waits by a glass wall, phone at his ear, looking out
departure board, destination blurred by motion
he walks with a leather weekender
boarding pass in his hand, destination covered by his thumb

days.location: car interior on an empty highway
beats: dashboard glow, the road empty
his hand turns the music down
his phone lights on the seat, he ignores it

days.concept: Photo of a watch and notebook.
beats: watch lying on an open notebook
his handwriting, unreadable
the black matchbook from Day 10 used as a bookmark
elevator doors open, he steps out
he crosses the lobby without looking around
he exits onto the street and puts on sunglasses
he waits at a crosswalk in a plain black tee, squinting at the sun, someone close took the photo
train window
the green book on a hotel bed
two coffees
helmet on a chair
rainy street
her bracelet on his wrist for some reason
side profile against a dark window, single sliver of light on the jaw
rain streams down glass
his silhouette appears behind it
he turns off the lamp
phone lights up with a message preview (unreadable)
his thumb hovers
he locks the phone and places it face down
the same table for two, both chairs empty, a single glass, the matchbook
he walks under streetlights
his shadow stretches ahead
he stops, looks up at an apartment window, walks on
the motorcycle parked alone at an overlook, helmet on the seat, he is nowhere in frame
handwritten line on paper under a desk lamp (text added in post)
the pen, his ring
the lamp switched off
his fingers hold a faded old photograph of an empty coastal road at dusk
from inside the room: he stands on the balcony, city mostly dark
wipers sweep, red lights blur
his hand tightens on the wheel
tunnel lights, then darkness
darkness, a passing light sweeps across his face
half his face lit, eyes steady
light gone
long corridor, flickering light
a door at the far end closes
silence
the green book face down on the sheets
a page with one underlined line (text added in post)
the gold bracelet used as a bookmark
his hands clasped on a dark table, ring and watch, knuckles slightly scraped (subtle, not graphic)
the empty apartment, dust in sunlight, calendar of unopened mail
door opens
he drops his keys and a leather weekender, sits without turning on the light
a bouquet of white flowers on the passenger seat, his hand on the gear stick
from beside: her hand rests on his shoulder as he sits, he looks down at it
he tries to cook, something goes wrong
she laughs behind the camera
he breaks and laughs, covers the lens with his hand
the same table, now both seats taken
two glasses touch
her hand with the bracelet finds his
she stands by the curtains in morning light, silhouette only

days.concept: Two coffees again, callback to Day 16.
beats: same marble table, two coffees, this time both their hands are around the cups

days.concept: Motorcycle ride with second helmet visible.
beats: the cream second helmet hangs from the bike
she climbs on behind him, face hidden by the helmet
they ride away along the coast

days.location: the same coastal road as the old photograph
beats: wide: the empty coastal road at dusk — matches the old photograph
two figures sit on a low wall by the parked bike
the shot frames exactly like the old photo
he reads at breakfast, she took it
her hand with the bracelet, coffee
view, unidentifiable coast
he looks back at her in an alley, unguarded, half a smile
her arms wrap around him from behind as he stands at the window, her face hidden in his back
two coffees
her bracelet on his wrist
the cream helmet
her laughing, blurred
their shoes by the door

days.concept: Argument implied through distance, no dialogue.
beats: they stand at opposite ends of a room
she picks up her tan bag
door closes, he does not move
he waits on a doorstep with white flowers; a door opens, only her hand visible taking them
from behind: they walk slowly
her head rests on his shoulder
they become two silhouettes in the lights
the Day 1 composition, but he looks away from the lens

days.location: unfamiliar city with a distinctive tower in the distance
beats: rooftop at night, a distant unfamiliar tower glowing; he stands with his back to camera
the tower lights blink once
he turns away and walks out of frame, leaving only the skyline
one suitcase zips shut; her tan bag is not in the hallway
car boot closes
departure board, destination blurred
POV: his hand holds a brass hotel key, the number hidden by his thumb, corridor ahead

days.location: mountain pass with snow at the edges
beats: the bike climbs a winding pass
he stops at the top, lifts his visor
he looks back down the road
the green book on a hotel desk
a darker underlined line (text added in post)
the hotel key beside it
the two-coffee table again, one cup untouched and cold, her chair empty

days.concept: Someone follows him from a distance.
beats: long lens: he walks ahead
the framing reveals the camera is following him
he stops; the frame freezes before he turns
he stands apart from the crowd, untouched drink, watching the door
his hand: ring, watch — and on the wrist, her thin gold bracelet
a vintage postcard showing the distant tower from Day 77, text obscured
the back: unreadable handwriting, a pressed white flower
the black matchbook beside it

days.concept: He looks at camera for the first time in weeks.
beats: slow push in on his profile
he turns his head
direct stare into the lens, held for two seconds
wide fog over cliffs
a tiny figure in a long black coat at the edge
the camera rises, he remains still

days.concept: Photo with a subtle clue referencing an old post.
beats: a hotel desk in a new city: the old coastal-road photograph is now pinned beside a second, newer photo of the same road — taken from the opposite direction

days.concept: Major cinematic Reel ending on an unanswered visual question.
days.location: the Day 10 restaurant, then the coastal road
beats: he enters the Day 10 restaurant; the table for two is set, one chair empty
on the empty chair: her gold bracelet and the cream helmet
he turns: a woman's hand touches his shoulder from off-frame — he looks at the camera — cut to black before anything is revealed
